text:
maria: Heads up — big customer (ACME EU) hit a blocker: their consolidated PO was split across APAC/NA/EMEA billing entities and the marketplace portal rejects the upload. invoices aren't linking to the PO. Raising for deal desk ops.

sara: which customer id? portal shows a 422 in the accept flow.

maria: cust-acme-3421. Error from portal: `billing_entity_mismatch` when it tries to attach invoice lineitems to pooled PO. Screenshot sent to thread.

aj: finance sees intercompany split flag = false on the PO. Did procurement request a single consolidated PO or separate entity POs?

maria: they sent one consolidated PO covering multiple subsidiaries. Procurement insisted on single PO for contract reasons.

liam: legal — is there a signature/msa issue having multiple entities on one PO? We had a redline before about entity-specific signatory.

liam: quick note: cross-entity signature ambiguity means our marketplace's PO ingestion can't verify signer authority. That's why it's failing validation.

sara: logs from invoice-acceptor show the rejection and retry loop:
```
2026-02-28T14:02:11Z ERROR attach_invoice: billing_entity_mismatch order_id=PO-12345 tenant=acme region=eu
2026-02-28T14:02:11Z INFO retrying in 200ms (attempt 1)
2026-02-28T14:02:12Z INFO retrying in 400ms (attempt 2)
2026-02-28T14:02:13Z ERROR final: invoice rejected permanent
```

aj: short-term workaround: can procurement re-issue separate POs per legal entity? That unblocks invoicing and recognition.

maria: customer is pushing back — they want single PO. Is there a platform fallback we can offer? e.g., auto-split the consolidated PO on ingestion and map lines to entities?

sara: platform doesn't have safe auto-split today — too risky for accounting reconciliation. We could add an 'accept-as-is' flag but need finance/legal signoff.

liam: legal won't sign off on auto-split without audit trail and explicit consent. If customer signs an attestation permitting auto-split, we can proceed with a controlled flow.

aj: finance prefers a manual split performed by procurement or Partner Ops to keep ledgers clean. We can accept temporary exception for one-off deals if revenue ops approves.

maria: action items: 1) maria to get customer attestation or confirm willingness to re-issue separate POs. 2) sara to open a ticket with runtime team to add a non-destructive auto-split prototype (audit-only) — logs only. 3) aj to loop in revenue ops for exception path. 

maria: any objections?

deploy-bot: invoice-acceptor v2.1.4 patched and deployed to staging with enhanced retry logging :rocket:

sara: thanks — I'll file ST-4523 and assign to eng-runtime for audit-only auto-split prototype. tagging @liam and @aj for sign-off once prototype exists. :eyes:

aj: I'll coordinate with revenue ops and finance today. If we get customer attestation, we can do partner-managed manual split in 24-48h.

maria: cool. I'll ping procurement and update the customer with the manual split option + ask about attestation. Will update thread.

sara: marking as high priority. keeping thread open.
